replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a statistical technique used to reduce the dimensionality of a dataset while preserving as much variance as possible. The steps involve standardizing the data, computing the covariance matrix, calculating the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the covariance matrix, sorting the eigenvalues in descending order, and selecting the top k eigenvalues. Then, you create a matrix of the top k eigenvectors and project the original data onto this matrix.
